meta.title: Felipe Rueda Rivera — Product Engineer · Cloud & Backend
meta.description: Cloud-native software engineer focused on designing, migrating and securing scalable architectures on AWS. Backend, microservices and AI-driven solutions (RAG).

hero.badge: Open to hybrid or remote work
hero.summary: I design, migrate and secure scalable architectures on AWS. I specialize in backend development, complex database migrations, resilient microservices and integrating AI-driven solutions — such as RAG — to automate complex data analysis.

about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm a Systems & Computer Engineering graduate from Universidad de los Andes, with experience building end-to-end cloud solutions in fast-paced startup and corporate environments.

Systems design is what drives me: from architecting information platforms from scratch on AWS to leading critical database migrations with zero downtime. I enjoy bringing AI to real problems, like automating the analysis of financial documents with RAG.

Away from the keyboard you'll find me discovering new cafés, training at the gym or learning languages. I love musicals — I've taken theater classes — and, honestly, technology is both my career and my hobby: I'm always exploring what's next.

uniandesRag.location: Office of the Vice President for Academic Affairs · Bogotá (remote, part-time)
highlights: Integrating generative AI into the university's institutional systems through Platypus, its project platform, in direct collaboration with the Faculty of Engineering and the Digital Transformation team.
Designing and deploying Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures that automate the creation and analysis of calls for academic projects.
Building backend REST APIs with Flask to orchestrate and serve AI models.
Integrating and evaluating multiple Large Language Models (LLMs) from various providers to optimize performance for specific use cases.

Lead the end-to-end development of Finidian's flagship Proptech platform, designed to streamline the mortgage process — from product definition and prioritization to its technical implementation in production.
Spearheaded a critical database migration from MongoDB to PostgreSQL, ensuring data integrity, minimizing downtime and optimizing query performance for scalable backend operations.
Design and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS, supporting high-availability microservices for fast-paced product iterations.
Collaborate in an Agile remote environment to streamline deployment processes and enhance overall system architecture.

Architected and deployed an end-to-end risk information system from scratch on AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, ECS, Route 53), migrating a legacy database, Java Spring Boot services and an Angular frontend to the cloud.

Built and scheduled Python-based ETL pipelines loading critical financial data while ensuring data integrity, following AWS security best practices: IAM least-privilege roles, KMS encryption and CloudWatch alerts.

Designed and developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) application using Python Flask and the OpenAI API to extract, analyze and automate the comparison of complex accounting policies across multiple financial statement PDFs.
Backend with Python TA: mentored students designing and building REST APIs with Flask and MySQL, supporting hands-on labs and design questions.
Introduction to Programming TA: guided first-year students through programming fundamentals and data analysis with Pandas and Matplotlib.

moirai.name: Moirai
moirai.description: Digital health twin built in 36 hours at Platanus Hack 26 Bogotá (Simulations track). It reads 9 biomarkers from a blood test, measures biological age with the PhenoAge clock and runs ten thousand paired Monte Carlo trajectories over ten years to recommend which habit buys you the most years per unit of effort.

andestrack.name: AndesTrack
andestrack.description: Web platform that connects your Garmin account to analyze the correlation between health habits and academic performance. Born to help balance university life, it integrates academic and personal data into a single tool that improves both results and well-being. Co-authored undergraduate thesis, advised by Mario Sánchez Puccini and published in the Séneca institutional repository. Built with Django and MySQL, deployed on Linux with Gunicorn.

ragAnalyzer.name: RAG Financial Analyzer
ragAnalyzer.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation application built with Python Flask and the OpenAI API that automatically extracts, analyzes and compares complex accounting policies across multiple financial statement PDFs.

riskPlatform.name: Cloud Risk Platform
riskPlatform.description: End-to-end risk information system on AWS: legacy database migration, Java Spring Boot microservices, Angular frontend and Python ETL pipelines with corporate-grade security.

items.title: Student Representative
items.description: Representing a constituency of 1,000+ students, my co-representative and I redefined the role at DISC Uniandes in 2024: we created "Un café Java con..." — 13 live interviews with department professors, now a podcast on Spotify —, I coordinated the design, quotation, production and official sale of the department's current hoodies, we organized the Turing Cup (sports and esports tournaments with 150+ participants) and the DISC Olympics of technical challenges, and I led DISC Week with a 20-volunteer team — always bridging students and academic leadership with data-driven feedback.

items.title: IEEEXtreme 17.0
items.description: Competed in IEEE's global programming competition (17,000+ participants) with team CabrasRecursivas — October 2023.

items.title: NVIDIA Certification · Anomaly Detection
items.description: Certificate of Competency in “Applications of AI for Anomaly Detection” from NVIDIA, earned at AI WEEK 2026 (October 2026): applied AI techniques to detect anomalous behavior in data, in a workshop hosted by NVIDIA, SoftServe, Universidad de los Andes and Escuela de Ingeniería de Antioquia.

items.description: 36-hour hackathon with 100+ highly skilled participants (August 2026). In a multidisciplinary team we built Moirai, a digital health twin for the Simulations track, with everyone contributing across development, architecture, design and concept.
